title: Chapter 447 The Tang Empire Is Destroyed
content:
Chapter 447 The Tang Empire Is Destroyed

But no matter where the celestial beings of the Tang Empire hid, at the moment when the protective formation was shattered, no matter how much they hid, they were destined to come out and face the majesty of the 12 celestial beings.

Although Chang'an City has an area of a hundred miles, it can be regarded as one of the largest cities in the world. It is the pride of the people of the entire Tang Empire on weekdays. When it comes to the Tang Empire, they are proud, and there are countless words of praise.

But no matter how glorious the title, how amazing wealth, and how huge the population of this city is, it can't change the fact that he is only a few steps away in the eyes of the eighth-level angel.

With a cultivation base of eighth level, one's own spiritual consciousness is extremely powerful, and with a single sweep of the divine sense, it can cover dozens of miles around.

No matter how big Chang'an City is, it is only about a hundred miles away. For those angels, even scanning alone is just a few thoughts, and it doesn't take much time at all.

But now the 12 heavenly immortals are attacking together, and with the superposition of spiritual thoughts, no matter how well the three heavenly immortals of the Tang Empire are hiding, they will definitely be able to find them out.

What's more, even if the three angels of the Tang Empire hid, or left Chang'an City directly, and went to other places to hide their names. For the 12 immortals, it is even a good thing.

After all, even if these 12 immortals have an absolute numerical advantage, the strength of the immortals crushing the Tang Empire is naturally a certainty, needless to say.

But this does not mean that the 12 immortals can suppress the three immortals of the Tang Empire intact.

You must know that the celestial beings of the Tang Empire are all relatively outstanding existences within the same level, and are generally in the middle and upper reaches, or completely in the upper reaches.

Usually against those angels who are in the lower reaches, it is not a problem to 1v2 or 1v3.

Among other things, let's talk about the remaining three immortals of the Tang Empire. Even if Yuan Tiangang was seriously injured, it would be no problem to face a weaker immortal alone.

As for the other two celestial beings, the recent celestial being was born as a genius born of the luck of the Tang Empire for thousands of years, the son of luck in the southern part of the Liao Zhai world, his personal aptitude is naturally outstanding, and his strength after becoming a celestial is also extremely amazing. One vs three is out of the question.

However, the founder of the Tang Empire, Taizu, has survived as a veteran celestial being for thousands of years, and his own heritage has accumulated extremely profoundly.

Whether it is mana accumulation or personal understanding of the Taoism of the immortal level, it is far beyond the strength of those ordinary immortals. They are already in the upper reaches of the immortal level. There is no pressure to pick three masters of the same level and the lower level.

Just the combination of these three angels, the combat power has reached seven downstream angels.

In a real fight, even if the Six Nations United Celestials have a sufficient number of advantages, casualties are absolutely inevitable. At least the fall of two or three people is foreseeable.

So if the celestial beings of the Tang Empire really escaped and surrendered the capital city of Chang'an, these 12 celestial beings would have absolutely no intention of tracking down their whereabouts, but would be overjoyed to declare their victory in this battle.

After all, the purpose of these people is to completely destroy the Tang Empire, and they don't really want to kill the three angels of the empire. Although there is no difference in a certain sense between the two, the actual implementation process and results are still very different.

But it's a pity that these celestial beings' ideas have not been realized, and they have not waited for their divine thoughts to thoroughly scan the entire Chang'an City to find out the hidden dangers.

The three heavenly immortals of the Tang Empire who had just been hiding in the dark to watch the play showed up on their own initiative, appeared in the midair of Chang'an City, and confronted the enemy on the opposite side.

They communicated a few words with each other, but because their respective goals were too different, there was a fundamental contradiction between them, and the talk broke down after a short while.

The words are finished, since each party does not agree with the other party's conditions, then in the end, there is only one fight, and whoever has the biggest fist will listen to whoever has it.

The momentum of their respective battles is extremely strong, and every move can spread to the surrounding area for several miles, and the damage brought about is even more serious. There is a specific example to illustrate it.

Take the city of Chang'an below as an example, as the heavenly immortals made their moves, they didn't have the slightest intention to restrain their aura. When they started fighting, they all tried their best and struck ruthlessly.

Under the influence of this kind of behavior, the Great Wall below became ruins everywhere, and countless people died on the spot. The survivors also stood on the spot in a daze, or cried, or ran back and forth yelling, obviously crazy.

These heavenly immortals have only fought dozens of times, and half of Chang'an City has been completely reduced to ruins. As for the rest, because they were a little far away from the center of the battle, they escaped for the time being.

But thinking about it, as the war intensifies, it is inevitable to step back in the previous area.

The casualties caused by such fierce fighting were even more appalling. Naturally, the remaining half of the residents of Chang'an City did not dare to stay here anymore. Countless people ran out of the houses and pushed and pulled each other on the crowded street. Everyone wanted to hurry up. Escape from this place of death.

But there are too many people. Chang'an City is very big, and there are also many people living in it, a total of 200 million people.

Even if half of these people died because of the battle just now, there are still 100 million left.

These 100 million people want to escape from an area in a short period of time, even if this area has a radius of tens of miles, it is not an easy task. The blockage, stampede and brawl that occurred therein emerged in an endless stream, which more seriously hindered the process of people escaping for their lives.

Sure enough, as these people pushed each other, the battle in the distance slowly spread to the surroundings. After all, it is impossible for all the eighth-level immortals to stay in one place all the time and fight each other one by one.

What they pay attention to is flexibility, mobility, and skill.

So distance yourself from each other, release your Taoism without reservation, release all your supernatural powers, let your combat power reach the peak, and survive this life-and-death battle. What those angels thought in their hearts.

As for how many Liming deaths they would cause if they completely released their destructive power, they didn't even think about it.

Isn't it just some untouchables? How could such an ant-like existence really attract those angels?

Their cultivation has reached their level, and there is a real difference between them and humans. The two do not belong to the same species at all, but they still retain the concept of human beings in their minds, and they are barely the same faction.

This is also the reason why life-and-death battles rarely occur between the monster race and the eighth-level gods of the human race. Even if there is a big war, it is because of other conflicts of interests, not because of the righteousness of the human race and monster race.

It is because they have reached their level, even if they share the name of humans and demons, they no longer belong to the same species as the lower-level humans and demons, and their sense of belonging to each other is extremely weak.
